UNITED Gi APCS CF nie tee

-er 43 3h

 
Pw Cy
~\ —

Executibe @rder

Tue HonoraBLE HENry T. RAINEY

As a mark of respect to the memory of the Honorable Henry T. Rainey, late
Speaker and Member of the House of Representatives of the United States, it is
hereby ordered that the flags on the White House and public buildings in the Dis-
trict of Columbia and the State of Illinois be placed at half mast on the day of the
funeral service at Carrollton, Illinois, Wednesday, August 22, 1934.

FRANKLIN D. ROOSEVELT.
THe Waite Houssz,
August 21, 1934.

[No. 6826]

operative_clauses.judgment_reason: ORIGINAL:EO:6826, complete span 0–850, contains one operative command, reproduced in CLAUSES:EO:6826#whole at 390–849: flags at the specified buildings and places are to be at half mast on Wednesday, August 22, 1934. The expressly named day limits the entire command; operative force expires at the end of that day. This establishes temporal expiration, not actual lowering or restoration of flags, funeral performance, or formal revocation. The commemorative explanation and signature create no independent continuing command.
